name: PLS Plantations Berhad
overview: 2026年公司主要业务动态集中在种植板块：鲜果串（FFB）产量按季披露，2026财年累计产量102,161.96公吨，较上年同期85,701.43公吨增加19.21%。公司未公告新增、缩减或出售业务线，亦未公告新合约。其他公告涉及 recurrent related party transactions 的股东授权更新、公司秘书变更及重大诉讼事项。
overview_en: In 2026, the main business developments were concentrated in the plantation segment: fresh fruit bunch (FFB) production was disclosed quarterly, with cumulative FY2026 production of 102,161.96 MT versus 85,701.43 MT in the prior year period, an increase of 19.21%. The company did not announce any new, reduced, or divested business lines, nor any new contracts.

segments.name: 种植
segments.note: 公司按季及按月披露鲜果串产量，2026财年累计产量较上年同期增加19.21%。
segments.note_en: The company disclosed FFB production quarterly and monthly, with cumulative FY2026 production up 19.21% year-on-year.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text: 披露2026年9月季度鲜果串产量33,360.67公吨，较上年同期26,151.96公吨增加27.56%。
actions.text_en: Disclosed FFB production for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 of 33,360.67 MT, up 27.56% from 26,151.96 MT a year earlier.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text_en: Disclosed FFB production for the quarter ended 30 June 2026 of 25,676.99 MT, up 9.15% from 23,524.68 MT a year earlier; cumulative 2026 production of 102,161.96 MT, up 19.21% from 85,701.43 MT.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text_en: Disclosed FFB production for the quarter ended 31 March 2026 of 20,950.07 MT, up 32.08% from 15,861.41 MT a year earlier; cumulative 2026 production of 76,484.97 MT, up 23.01% from 62,176.75 MT.

actions.title: DISCLOSURE ON QUARTERLY PRODUCTION
actions.text_en: Disclosed FFB production for the quarter ended 31 December 2025 of 29,382.94 MT, up 31.75% from 22,301.27 MT a year earlier; cumulative 2025 production of 55,534.90 MT, up 19.91% from 46,315.34 MT.
